<mxCell id="notes" value="<font color="#FF0000">* Lambda → CloudWatch Logs arrows omitted for clarity.<br>* Lambda → SSM arrows omitted: Gmail connect, Reconcile and Import read the Gemini key and Google OAuth client secret from SSM.<br>* All Lambdas run outside the VPC; Aurora is reached only via the RDS Data API (no NAT Gateway).<br>* API Gateway rejects requests without the CloudFront secret origin header (read from SSM).<br>* Statement PDFs and their passwords never leave the browser; only parsed rows reach the API.<br>* Dashed = optional or configuration link. Staging: same layout in a separate account, without WAF, Gemini free tier, Cognito's default email sender and a testing-mode OAuth client.</font>" div.font:
* Lambda → CloudWatch Logs arrows omitted for clarity.
* Lambda → SSM arrows omitted: Gmail connect, Reconcile and Import read the Gemini key and Google OAuth client secret from SSM.
* All Lambdas run outside the VPC; Aurora is reached only via the RDS Data API (no NAT Gateway).
* API Gateway rejects requests without the CloudFront secret origin header (read from SSM).
* Statement PDFs and their passwords never leave the browser; only parsed rows reach the API.
* Dashed = optional or configuration link. Staging: same layout in a separate account, without WAF, Gemini free tier, Cognito's default email sender and a testing-mode OAuth client.
